en: The image is a colorized photograph of a lush park scene, featuring a large tree in the center, various types of bushes and flowering plants in the foreground, and walking paths weaving through the greenery. There are some buildings visible in the background and the atmosphere suggests a peaceful, well-maintained public space. The postcard has visible text at the bottom right.
